successCriteria.description: PgBalanceRepository satisfies the IBalanceRepository interface with all six methods: findByEmployeeId returns Balance[], findByEmployeeIdAndLeaveType returns Balance | null, findByEmployeeIdAndFiscalYear returns Balance[], create inserts and returns Balance, update applies partial changes via dynamic COLUMN_MAP and returns Balance | null, deductDays atomically decrements remaining_days, increments used_days, and sets status to 'exhausted' when remaining reaches 0 or below

BalanceService satisfies the IBalanceService interface: getBalance delegates to repository.findByEmployeeIdAndLeaveType, getBalances delegates to repository.findByEmployeeId, hasSufficientBalance returns true when remainingDays >= requestedDays and false when balance is null or insufficient, deductBalance throws BalanceNotFoundError when balance is null, throws InsufficientBalanceError when remainingDays < days, and delegates to repository.deductDays on success

BalanceController exposes two route handlers: getBalance returns 200 with the Balance object when found, 404 when balance is null, and 500 on unexpected errors; getBalances returns 200 with Balance[] (including empty array) and 500 on unexpected errors

Balance routes are registered as a Fastify plugin that wires PgBalanceRepository → BalanceService → BalanceController, with the more-specific route (/:employeeId/:leaveType) registered before the less-specific route (/:employeeId) to prevent Fastify route shadowing

PgAuditLogRepository satisfies the IAuditLogRepository interface: findByEntity returns AuditLog[] ordered by created_at DESC, create inserts and returns AuditLog, findAll builds dynamic WHERE clauses from optional filters (entityType, performedBy, fromDate, toDate) using indexed parameterized placeholders and returns AuditLog[] ordered by created_at DESC

All three unit test suites pass: balance.repository.spec.ts (mock pg Pool, covers all six repository methods including deductDays exhausted-status transition and update fallback-to-findById when no valid keys), balance.service.spec.ts (mock IBalanceRepository, covers getBalance/getBalances delegation, hasSufficientBalance edge cases including null balance, deductBalance error paths), audit-log.repository.spec.ts (mock pg Pool, covers findByEntity ordering, create, findAll with no filters, individual filters, and combined filters)

constraints: All database access must go through the repository layer (GP-001) — the BalanceService and BalanceController must never call pool.query directly; they delegate to IBalanceRepository / IAuditLogRepository exclusively
All SQL queries must use parameterized placeholders ($1, $2, …) — no string interpolation of user-supplied values into query text
The database pool must be imported from src/shared/db/connection as a named export `pool` — no alternative connection creation or direct pg.Pool instantiation in repository files
The Balance table is named `balances` (not `leave_balances`) — all repository SQL must reference this table name
The AuditLog table uses a `changes` column (JSONB) — not `old_values`/`new_values` columns. The `changes` field in the AuditLog entity is typed as `Record<string, unknown>`

Balance routes must NOT be registered in src/app.ts during this phase — integration is deferred to a follow-up phase per docs/ARCHITECTURE.md. The routes plugin must be exported and independently testable
The BalanceService must accept a pre-calculated day count — the calendar-days-inclusive calculation itself lives in the leave-request module. The service must not compute day counts from dates
outOfScope: Registering balance routes in src/app.ts — deferred to a follow-up integration phase per docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
RBAC enforcement on balance endpoints — auth middleware and role guards are not yet implemented; the controller currently has no auth checks

Audit log creation from balance operations — GP-002 requires audit records for state-changing operations, but the audit-log module is only providing the repository in this phase; the orchestration of audit writes during balance mutations belongs to the leave-request phase

entityInvariants.invariant: A Balance row is uniquely identified by the combination of (employeeId, leaveType, fiscalYear). The status field must transition from 'active' to 'exhausted' when remainingDays reaches 0 or below after a deductDays operation. usedDays + remainingDays must equal totalEntitlement at all times.

AuditLog records are append-only — once created they are never updated or deleted. The changes field captures a snapshot of the mutation as a JSONB object. Every state-changing operation in the system must produce exactly one AuditLog record.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Returns null when the balance row does not exist. The caller (BalanceService) must translate null into a BalanceNotFoundError. The SQL must atomically update remaining_days, used_days, and status in a single UPDATE statement.

Throws BalanceNotFoundError (code: 'NOT_FOUND') when no balance exists for the given employeeId + leaveType. Throws InsufficientBalanceError (code: 'INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE') when remainingDays < days. On success, returns the updated Balance after delegation to repository.deductDays.
Returns boolean. Never throws. Returns false when balance is null (no balance record exists) or when remainingDays < requestedDays. Returns true when remainingDays >= requestedDays.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The Balance entity shape (id, employeeId, leaveType, totalEntitlement, usedDays, remainingDays, fiscalYear, status, createdAt, updatedAt) must match the interface defined in balance.model.ts — repository mapRowToBalance must produce objects conforming to this interface

The AuditLog entity shape (id, entityType, entityId, action, performedBy, changes, createdAt) must match the interface defined in audit-log.model.ts — repository mapRowToAuditLog must produce objects conforming to this interface

Error classes must carry a `.code` property: InsufficientBalanceError.code = 'INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE', BalanceNotFoundError.code = 'NOT_FOUND', AuditLogValidationError.code = 'VALIDATION_ERROR' — matching the error response contract in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
The BalanceStatus enum values ('active', 'exhausted') must be imported from src/shared/types/index.ts — the deductDays CASE expression must use the string literal 'exhausted' matching the enum value

integrationPoints.why: Both PgBalanceRepository and PgAuditLogRepository import the shared pg Pool for all database operations
